callouts.id: 制造telescoping sum求和或求乘积#1
callouts.title: telescoping sum
callouts.body: 但凡我们制造出$f(k+1)-f(k)=g(k)$的形式，我们是有办法直接表示出来$f(k)$的和的。也就是说，我们可以通过函数在整数点处的所有差分的信息还原出函数本身。从这个角度上来说，telescoping sum比较**类似于离散类型的，微积分基本定理**。

classification_result.id: 制造telescoping sum求和或求乘积#1

if_strategy_template.summary_en: If one can rewrite a sequence so that \(f(k+1)-f(k)=g(k)\), then summing \(g(k)\) telescopes and allows recovery of \(f\) from its discrete differences. This is analogous to a discrete version of the fundamental theorem of calculus.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when a summand can be expressed as a difference of consecutive terms, making partial sums collapse.

callouts.id: 制造telescoping sum求和或求乘积#5
callouts.title: 想法2.1
callouts.body: 如果我们想要求$\prod _{k=1}^n c_k$，而我们又发现$c_k=a_k\cdot \frac{b_k}{b_{k+1}}$那么其中$\prod_k a_k$是简单的或者已知的，那么$$\prod _{k=1}^n c_k=\left(\prod_{k=1}^n a_k \right) \prod_{k=1}^n \frac{b_k}{b_{k+1}}=\left(\prod_{k=1}^n a_k \right)\frac{b_1}{b_{n+1}}$$

classification_result.id: 制造telescoping sum求和或求乘积#5

if_strategy_template.summary_en: If \(c_k=a_k\\cdot \\frac{b_k}{b_{k+1}}\) and the product of the \(a_k\) is simple or known, then the product of the \(c_k\) reduces to a telescoping quotient. This gives $$\\prod_{k=1}^n c_k=\\left(\\prod_{k=1}^n a_k\ight)\\frac{b_1}{b_{n+1}}.$$
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when each factor can be decomposed into a simple factor times a ratio of consecutive auxiliary terms.

callouts.id: 制造telescoping sum求和或求乘积#8
callouts.title: 例子2.4
callouts.body:
$$\prod_{n\geq 0} \cos\left(\frac{x}{2^{n+1}}\right)=\frac{\sin(x)}{x}$$

* 考虑到正弦函数的二倍角公式$$\sin(x)=2\sin(x/2)\cos(x/2)$$这个式子在当前情境下可以写成$$\cos\left(\frac{x}{2^{n+1}}\right)=\frac{\sin\left(\frac{x}{2^{n}}\right)}{2\sin\left(\frac{x}{2^{n+1}}\right)}$$于是$$\prod_{n= 0}^{N} \cos\left(\frac{x}{2^{n+1}}\right)=\frac{1}{2^{N+1}}\prod_{n=0}^{N}\frac{\sin\left(\frac{x}{2^{n}}\right)}{\sin\left(\frac{x}{2^{n+1}}\right)}=\frac{1}{2^{N+1}}\frac{\sin(x)}{\sin\left(\frac{x}{2^{N+1}}\right)}\to \frac{\sin(x)}{x}$$

classification_result.id: 制造telescoping sum求和或求乘积#9

if_problem.statement_en:
Let \(q\\geq 2\) be a positive integer, and let the real number \(a\) satisfy \(|a|<1\). Show that
$$\\prod_{n\\geq 0}(1+a^{q^n}+\\cdots+a^{(q-1)q^n})=\\frac{1}{1-a}.$$
